Name: Ferite Sostenudo
Casting Time: 1 reaction, taken when a friendly creature within reach would be knocked below one hit point.
Description: You concentrate on a single sustained performance, trying to sustain the same notes as long as possible as they take a physical form and cling onto a creature's skin to make sure they stay up even while being at the brink of their life. While concentrating on this spell one target creature of your choice cannot become Unconscious or have their amount of hit points be knocked under one, but if they suffer a cumulative amount of damage equal to their maximum hit points while you are still concentrating on this spell, this spell ends early as the notes holding them together burst open, instantly having you and the protected creature suffer 6d8 thunder damage and 2 points of Exhaustion.
